build_rule_execution_plane_v1: Looks up release ID and executes every enabled release member whose pattern_type is candidate_constraint, phrase_pattern or dependency_pattern. It has no pilot rule-code selector or activation grant check.
run_canonical_legacy_compatibility_v140: Passes one p_release_code through morphology, phrase, construction, predicate, clause, dependency and rule-plane stages. Release status build/golden/shadow/canary/active is accepted.
consequence: Disabling other release members to isolate subject_of_predicate could change its upstream inputs. An isolated one-rule SQL pilot needs a rule-plane selector or separate execution contract that preserves the existing structural release.
scope: Specific current Production function definitions. This does not prove no alternative pilot function exists elsewhere.
